profile.headline: Senior Automation Leader | SCADA Systems | Team Leadership | Strategic Project Delivery
profile.summary: Barry-Wehmiller Design Group leverages its Senior Software Engineer’s expertise in industrial automation to deliver innovative SCADA solutions and advanced control systems. They specialize in Ignition, PLC programming, and automation technology to enable seamless system integration across diverse industries.  I am an experienced automation and SCADA systems professional with over 30 years in industrial controls, systems integration, and engineering leadership. My background spans municipal infrastructure, oil & gas, manufacturing, food and beverage, OEM support and data centers — consistently focused on delivering high-reliability systems and driving operational excellence. In my current role at Barry-Wehmiller Design Group, I lead a cross-functional engineering team on a high-impact SCADA deployment for a data center. I collaborate with regional leadership to support business development, lead technical strategy, and mentor delivery teams across disciplines. I bring both hands-on systems depth and a strategic mindset, with a career foundation in engineering execution, cross-functional alignment, and scalable automation architecture. I remain committed to developing teams and solutions that deliver excellence to the business and its clients. Open to leadership conversations in the future that align with these principles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer
Site team lead for a high-profile data center SCADA deployment. Manage cross-discipline team execution, align technical scope with client and internal leadership expectations, and support proposal development with regional management.

positions.title: DFW Engineering Manager/Automation S.M.E.
positions.description:
Develop SCADA applications predominantly but necessarily limited to Ignition. Support, design, and program automated solutions for a variety of industries. 

Assist and lead when necessary Strata's expansion into the ever-growing North Texas markets.

positions.title: Automation Consultant
positions.description: Program and service SCADA, PLC and other equipment used in automation.

positions.title: Application Engineer/PLC Programmer
positions.description: Program and commission PLC program as required by Industrial Automation group.

positions.title: Director of Programming
positions.description: Responsible for securing  and managing talent for the programming of automated industrial equipment such as PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA systems. Additionally responsible for standards and guidelines.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
Develop, design, test and install automated control systems as specified for the Water and
Wastewater industry.

positions.title: Director of Automation ASU and Onsite
positions.description:
• Direct automation efforts for air separation units (ASU). 
• Selected and developed SCADA system for ‘Command Center’ which collected statistical data.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the company’s owner to develop an automated controls system that dispensed
foam into concrete. This included choosing the platform and developing; PLC, HMI, SCADA, RFID, 
and variety of instruments and controls as well as various mechanical aspects of the system. 

• Listed inventor on company patents and application for patents: 

o US Patent No: 8,408,781

o US Patent Application No: 2013/0180,717

o US Patent Application No: 2013/0148,459

positions.title: Electrical Engineer/Programmer
positions.description:
• Six Sigma - Value Based Product Development (VBPD): Developed a new PLC control strategy to 
improve the ability to store and communicate data. 

• Efforts included product research, negotiating component prices, providing the internal 
promotion and training, overseeing documentation and marketing releases, developing 
specifications, providing customer and field service training and support.

• Directly overseeing alpha and beta tests. 
• Developed a web-based system, which allowed customer to access their system data over the Internet. 

• System was hosted on a small PC in the equipment’s control panel that transferred information 
via satellite to a web server located at the server. 

• Responsible for the development of a PC-based product line, which provided a graphical means 
of interfacing with the PLC (Siemens IPC60 and Omron).

• In charge of the development of new products and PLC programming as production demands 
occurred.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer/Programmer
positions.description:
Electrical Engineer for Systems integrator and panel shop

• Developed PLC programs to meet the custom requirements for systems integration.

• Supported sales teams with pricing and initial scope and design for providing customer quotes 
and/or bids.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer/Programmer
positions.description:
• Responsible for the development of electrical controls systems to operate horizontal
centrifuges. Develop the PLC program and HMI interface. Resulting product became a ‘staple’ 
for the company. 

• Worked with team to developed a unique system which would dissipate the over voltage of 
the DC buss system on the Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) caused by regeneration of the 
mechanical linked motors.

positions.title: Electrical Assembler/Technician
positions.description:
Wired and assembled electrical controllers.
Assisted engineering department with drawing edits and interpretations
Assisted the test facilities with wiring and termination

patents.title: System, Method and Apparatus for Entraining Air in Concrete
patents.description: S. Patent & Trademark Office: "A method of preparing a concrete composition includes utilizing a controller to control a process including circulating process water in a process water supply loop for a predetermined period while monitoring and controlling the temperature and flow rate of the process water, circulating aqueous-based air entrainment solution in an aqueous-based air entrainment solution supply loop for the predetermined period and controlling the flow rate of the aqueous-based air entrainment solution and after the predetermined period of time in which the flow of process water and aqueous-based air entrainment solution have stabilized, simultaneously actuating valves to divert and mix the process water, the aqueous-based air entrainment solution and compressed air to produce an air-entrained foam and mixing the foam with a concrete composition.
